items.summaryShort: Bug0 Releases QA Agent to Automate Regression Testing With Cached Playwright Replays. QA Agent is a new source-available Playwright library for agentic browser regression testing.

items.title: How to Make Artificial Intelligence More Environmentally Sustainable
items.summaryShort: How to Make Artificial Intelligence More Environmentally Sustainable. IT is responsible for about 2 - 4% of all global emissions, and electricity use at Microsoft and Google has climbed because of AI, according to their own reports.

items.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
items.summaryShort: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity. Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

items.title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
items.summaryShort: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO. A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.
